subject.title: [Feature Request] Add config encryption for credentials at rest

question: Should OpenClaw add native encrypted-at-rest credential storage, and if so should the first supported model be OS keychain-backed migration, passphrase sealing, or a narrower SecretRef-only policy?
rationale: The choice changes the trust boundary for local config/auth files and affects upgrades, service startup, backups, recovery, and provider authentication semantics.

options.title: Approve staged native design
options.body: Adopt a staged keychain/passphrase design with doctor migration and recovery tests before merging implementation PRs.

options.title: Limit core to SecretRefs
options.body: Keep native encryption out of core and invest only in SecretRef coverage, docs, and external secret-provider plugins.

options.title: Pause pending security design
options.body: Leave the issue open without implementation until security owners define the durable key-management and migration contract.

recommendation.title: Approve staged native design
recommendation.body: Adopt a staged keychain/passphrase design with doctor migration and recovery tests before merging implementation PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent secrets/security history and own the open partial auth-store sealing PR that overlaps this decision.
